name: Mandiri Bintan Marathon 2026
short_description: Mandiri Bintan Marathon 2026 is on Sunday 22 November 2026 at Lagoi Bay in Bintan Resorts, Bintan, over 3 km, 5 km, 10 km, 21.1 km and 42.195 km.
ai_summary: Mandiri Bintan Marathon 2026 is the 5th edition, presented by Bintan Resorts in collaboration with iSport, with up to 5,000 runners. The 3 km Family Run and 5 km Fun Run are on Saturday 21 November, and the 10 km, half marathon (21.1 km) and full marathon (42.195 km) are on Sunday 22 November. The venue is Lagoi Bay / Plaza Lagoi in Bintan Resorts, and the organiser describes the course as clean, flat roads free from vehicles. The 2026 theme is "Run and Discover: Restore Our Mangroves", and part of each entry fee goes to mangrove replanting.

core_facts.venue: Lagoi Bay / Plaza Lagoi, Bintan Resorts

faqs.question: What are the cut-off times at Mandiri Bintan Marathon 2026?
faqs.answer: The race categories page lists a 6.5-hour cut-off for the full marathon, 4 hours for the half marathon and 2.5 hours for the 10 km. The same page marks its 2026 details as TBC, so check the final race guide before race day.

faqs.question: Where and when is race pack collection for Mandiri Bintan Marathon 2026?
faqs.answer: Race pack collection is on Friday 20 November 2026 from 10:00 to 18:00 at Plaza Lagoi. Bring the e-voucher and the identity card used to register; a representative can collect with a signed power of attorney letter and the required documents.
